text:
Alex P: Quick sync — we need a lightweight, repeatable SI co-sell handoff for cloud marketplace + hardware partners. Problems: duplicate leads, unclear AE ownership, slow escalations. Can we agree on a 3-rule draft below?

Maya S: +1. We lose velocity when partner submits a lead and no AE is assigned. Can the partner lead form require an AE/email or else route to SDR?

Ben K: We can. Draft rule 1: Every partner-submitted lead must have either an AE email OR a mapped account (CRM ID). If neither, auto-route to SDR queue with partner follow-up.

Alicia R: Add a tech-touch flag — anything with infra risk or >$250k ARR goes to SE + Solutions AE. Low-touch marketplace leads go to partner-specialist SDR first.

Alex P: Proposed 3 rules (working draft):
```
rule 1: partner_lead.form must include (ae_email OR crm_account_id) else -> SDR_partner_queue
rule 2: if lead.estimated_value >= 250000 OR lead.category in ["onprem", "hardware-integration"] -> route to AE + SE + Partnerships
rule 3: attach partner_id and partner_lead_id to CRM; add tag partner:handshake + region tag
```

Ben K: Escalation SLAs suggestion: initial ack by AE/SDR within 24h, deep triage (SE + AE) within 72h, exec escalation window 5 business days. Add automated reminders at 24h and 72h.

Maya S: 24h ack ok. We need exceptions (holiday/regional). Also want a Slack reminder in #partnerships and a weekly partner-lag report to Sales Ops.

Alicia R: Operational note: include a mandatory account-enrichment step before routing to SE. If no CRM match, tag as "needs-enrich" and Solutions will enrich CSV -> I can own first 10 in pilot.

Alex P: Logistics: I'll draft a one-pager with these rules + a simple account mapping template. We should share a Google sheet for account mapping (read: Partnerships + Sales + Solutions access) and wire a webhook so new rows ping #partnerships.

Ben K: I'll stand up the sheet and add a zap to post new-rows to channel. Also will add a small ownership matrix in the sheet: columns = partner, region, default_AE, backup_AE, partner_owner (partnerships).

Maya S: Also need CRM fields: partner_source, partner_lead_id, partner_owner. I'll open a salesforce ticket to add them.

Alex P: Who will prep the external-facing doc for AccelSys / HW vendor next week? I can do the internal one-pager. We should run the external doc by Legal and Sales Ops.

Maya S: I'll take the AccelSys intro call Friday 10am PT and can help with the external doc.

Ben K: :thumbsup: I'll set reminders and add the sheet link in a follow-up message.

Alicia R: Pilot plan: run this for marketplace + 2 HW partners for 4 weeks, measure avg ack time, % leads routed correctly, duplicate lead rate.

Alex P: Perfect. Action items:
- Alex: internal one-pager + share sheet by Tue EOD
- Ben: create sheet + webhook + weekly report
- Maya: SFDC ticket + AccelSys call Fri 10am PT
- Alicia: own enrichment pilot (first 10 leads)

Alex P: tagging this thread as the canonical thread for rollout planning. Will post the one-pager once ready. Thanks everyone. :pray:
